# Compatibility fixtures

The Regrow-8 CPU and ALU archives are the published global16 fixtures. [Regrow-8 results directory](https://github.com/quietmaintainer/Regrow-8/tree/main/examples/machine_recipe/results)

`node-global16` contains a generated text sample, its GRF1 recipe, and its GRP1 archive. The former Node codec packed the sample with `span` text, automatic templates, the 256 KiB text window, and 5% global16 parity.
